truth: Canonical main baseline is 649002eebc6e378026f324df5d04adb3653c8b64 after PR #61 landed consumer Friction Memory reachability.
Whole-product reselection selected SONG-01-INTERACTION-01 because REQ-SCOPE-124 is a REQUIRED MINIMUM Gate-B blocker on the active Song / Produce / Learn journey.
ASK/ADVISE/TRY/DO remains the authority dimension. DO IT / WITH ME / SHOW ME / EXPLAIN WHY / LET ME TRY is a separate learning/collaboration-depth dimension and cannot grant execution authority.
Live N0TE2 contains AuthorityService, ExecutionEligibilityGate, capability routing, LearningMemory, SkillMemory and the consumer Learning journey but no first-class interaction-depth model.

The bounded implementation is per-job and bound to one real Learning episode; it is not a permanent Artist personality setting and does not mature into taste or Skill evidence merely because a mode was selected.

DO IT means N0TE may carry the job only as far as already-verified capability and authority permit. Where no executor is bound, the consumer result must remain truthful rather than simulating execution.
WITH ME, SHOW ME, EXPLAIN WHY and LET ME TRY must produce materially distinct roles and next-step behavior, not five labels over identical output.
Mode planning is read-only product behavior and must bind current active Song plus Learning evidence/decision state so stale guidance fails closed.
Consumer HTTP tests must stay inside the shell runtime thread boundary; persisted state inspection occurs after shell shutdown.
Execution evidence remains separate from authored tests; absent hosted or local execution remains UNOBSERVED.
After this increment lands or blocks, globally reselect rather than following interaction-code adjacency.
